reason: Procedural amendment to 1974 Budget Act is classic capture vector: appears routine but procedural changes to appropriations flow can redirect fiscal discipline mechanisms, create carve-outs, or enable fast-track spending without standard veto/reconciliation friction. Title's 'and for other purposes' is red flag for hidden riders.
vectors: Fiscal bleed: procedural manipulation of Congressional Budget Act can weaken deficit controls or enable TGA flow redirection
Regulatory capture: 'certain procedures' language suggests selective exemptions from spending scrutiny for targeted actors
Entitlement erosion: procedural changes often precursor to reconciliation rule manipulation that enables cuts to mandatory spending
title: To amend the Congressional Budget and Impoundment Control Act of 1974 to establish certain procedures for consideration of annual appropriation bills, and for other purposes.
